subject: Staged prepay governance, invoice ops & VAT evidence checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@brightbridge.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: finance@brightbridge.com
Date: 2025-07-01T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Annual prepay drawdown plan and VAT evidence request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for last week's call. We're moving to finalize the annual prepay (committed spend) for BrightBridge and need a concise ops checklist so our AP team can process the up-front payment and monthly drawdowns. Specifically could you confirm: 

- The invoicing cadence Redwood requires for a EUR-denominated prepay (monthly or milestone-based).
- Preferred invoice remit fields (exact remit name, bank details, and PO number placement).
- VAT certificate or tax residence evidence we should attach to the payment for VAT reclaim.
- Any preferred invoice template or fields that speed GL mapping on our side.

We'd like to complete the wire on July 15 if we can get the documents this week. I've CC'd our finance mailbox for follow-up.

Also attaching our standard PO template (sent separately by finance@brightbridge.com).

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Cole
Head of Finance, BrightBridge Analytics
Samantha.Cole@brightbridge.com

---
Attachment: BrightBridge_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf)

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@brightbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, finance@brightbridge.com
Date: 2025-07-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay drawdown plan and VAT evidence request

Samantha — thanks, and good plan to aim for a July 15 wire. Below is a compact ops checklist and proposed cadence that typically clears AP quickly. I've also attached a Redwood invoice template and our VAT cert for your records.

Quick answers up front:
- Invoicing cadence: We can issue a single up-front invoice for the committed amount (net of any agreed discount) and then post monthly drawdown credit memos against that invoice. Alternatively we can issue monthly invoices pre-funded from the prepay; both are common. BrightBridge preference?
- Remit fields: use 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' as remit name; bank details on attached invoice template — please include your PO# in the invoice header and in the wire reference.
- VAT evidence: attached 'VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf' is our tax residence doc. If BrightBridge requires a local withholding statement, let us know which jurisdiction and we'll coordinate.
- Template: attached XLS with the exact fields our AP systems map to (invoice number, PO, remit, VAT amount, tax id).

Proposed schedule (if you confirm by EOD July 2):
1) July 6: Redwood issues a single up-front invoice (Invoice A) for the committed amount, net terms COD.
2) July 15: BrightBridge wires funds to Redwood bank account (wire ref: BRB-2025-001).
3) Aug 1 and monthly thereafter: Redwood posts drawdown credit memos and monthly usage statements tied to Invoice A.

Operational asks (who does what):
- BrightBridge AP: Send PO# and confirm remit bank info matches the attached template. (action: finance@brightbridge.com)
- Redwood Billing: Issue Invoice A and provide tax receipt once funds clear. (action: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com)
- Redwood Tax: Provide VAT certificate (attached). (action: kimberly.park@redwood.com)

I've CC'd Kimberly and Marissa to confirm the invoice numbering and that the drawdown credit memos will include monthly usage detail. 

If you prefer monthly invoices instead of a single up-front invoice + credit memos, say so and we'll switch cadence.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

---
Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf (application/pdf)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@brightbridge.com>
Cc: finance@brightbridge.com
Date: 2025-07-01T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay drawdown plan and VAT evidence request

Looping in a couple of operational details from billing/tax: 

- Invoice numbering: We'll issue Invoice A as 'RWI-BRB-2025-INV-0001' and subsequent credit memos as 'RWI-BRB-2025-CM-0001' etc. Marissa will confirm numbering in our ledger once approved.
- Currency and GL mapping: Because the contract is EUR, we will show amounts in EUR and include USD conversion in the monthly statement for your US subsidiary if needed. Please confirm which entity is wiring (BrightBridge EU entity or BrightBridge LLC) so VAT flow is correct.
- VAT reclaim: Our VAT cert should be sufficient for EU reclaim in most cases. If BrightBridge is treating this as intra-community supply, please share your VAT ID and customer tax residence form.
- PO placement: please place PO# in both the invoice header and the 'Remittance Reference' field on the wire. That avoids delays in reconciliation.

Marissa — once you confirm invoice numbers I'll queue up the invoice for July 6.

Samantha — other than PO and wiring entity, are you able to confirm July 15 wire timing? If finance wants a staged release rather than one wire we can accommodate a two-tranche approach (50/50) as well.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Billing & Collections, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

---
Attachment referenced: SOW_BrightBridge_v1.2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@brightbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, finance@brightbridge.com
Date: 2025-07-02T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay drawdown plan and VAT evidence request

Samantha — thanks for the quick replies. Confirming next steps and owners so we can close the loop today: 

Agreed cadence: single up-front invoice (Invoice A) with monthly drawdown credit memos tied to Invoice A. BrightBridge confirmed wiring entity: BrightBridge Analytics GmbH (EU VAT ID provided separately).

Owners and deadlines: 
- BrightBridge AP (finance@brightbridge.com): Share PO# and initiate wire by July 15 (wire ref: BRB-2025-001).
- Redwood Billing (Marissa): Issue Invoice A on July 6 with number 'RWI-BRB-2025-INV-0001'.
- Redwood Tax (Kimberly): Standby to provide any additional jurisdictional withholding paperwork if requested by BrightBridge local counsel.

Attachments included in this thread for AP upload: Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx, VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf, SOW_BrightBridge_v1.2.pdf. 

If BrightBridge prefers a two-tranche wire, please state amounts and dates; otherwise we'll plan for the single July 15 transfer and begin issuing monthly credit memos on Aug 1. Once finance confirms PO# I'll push the invoice live.

I'll mark this as 'action required' in HubSpot and add the invoice to our billing queue. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BRB-2025-001

Appreciate the speedy turnaround — let's aim to close funding this month.

Best,
Rishi

Redwood Inference
